rules.itemCount: Randy's house rule, wired: every dyna boss drops 5 to 7 items (CountMin 5, CountMax 7 on the band hash). The 2003 team-size rumor is not used. Corpse capacity stays 9. Adds are not on this table.
rules.qlWindow: Funcom forum guide AO Tips: max QL is boss level x 1.25 and min QL is boss level x 0.75, for items that vary in quality. A second player says +/-20 percent. A third says about +/-10 levels, and narrower for a named single-QL weapon. This file uses x0.75 to x1.25, which is LevelMod 25 on our roller.
rules.notPerCamp: The primary dyna-camps page does not give each camp its own loot table. The same pool is shared by every dyna whose level can roll that QL. Per-dyna signature items below are that shared pool, not a unique drop proven for that camp.
rules.primaryDrops: Primary page: bosses can drop items that cannot be bought or obtained as a mission reward. Named there: Nova Dillon armor, Kirch Kevlar armor, Sekutek Chilled Plasteel armor, nano programs usually as instruction discs (including Nullity Sphere 150504, Nullity Sphere MK II 150503, and Grid Armor), Empty Data Receptacle Container 275056, and profession/breed locked weapons (AOFroobs topic 4128).
rules.mobLevels: Primary page prose: the map number is the approximate boss level and regular mobs are 5 to 10 levels below the boss. The table on the same page gives an exact boss level and mob range per camp. That table is 174 rows, waypoints 0-173, and it matches dyna-camps.csv. This file uses the table.
rules.nanos: Wired form is the instruction disc when itemnames has Instruction Disc (program name). The disc is placed in every band whose QL window contains the disc QL. If no disc exists, the NanoCrystal row is used (Nullity, Grid Armor). Bite of the Wind disc is 161410 at QL 103, same QL as crystal 161148.
rules.gridArmor: Named on the primary page inside the nano sentence. Crystals verified in items.dat: Mk I 155190 QL 60, Mk II 155192 QL 93, Mk III 155191 QL 116, Mk IV 155193 QL 140. The linked Grid Armor guide also lists missions, plants, Biomare, and Claw Camp, so these are not dyna-only.
rules.adds: Primary page: regular mobs drop what that family drops anywhere else. Cyborgs drop Miy's armor. This proposal does not change add loot.

wiring: Not wired. ItemTemplates.json does not yet have DYNA, DYNW, DYNN, or DYNR.

A category hash must only offer children whose QL range contains the roll. Our LeafSpan treats a one-template item as valid at every QL above its Quality and then stamps the rolled QL on it. Fixed breakpoints (Nullity Sphere QL 90, a QL 50 weapon, a NanoCrystal) need an explicit top, or they will mint at the boss QL.
NS01, NS02, EDRC, CMTR, and CMHK already exist and can stay.
OFAB on the current boss table is not supported by the dyna guides.
Chances are placeholders. The guides never publish percents.
